description: Hand-authored anchor vectors. Every byte is recomputed by verify-anchors.sh with openssl, sharing no code with the LATTICE minting libraries. Normalization outputs cite the UCD 16.0.0 lines that justify them.

sets.description: Derived hash: the SKU example of rdf-sparql-patterns-guide.md Chapter 5.
Claimed surrogate: the email claim of rdf-sparql-patterns-guide.md §6.1, with a caller-supplied surrogate.

ucd: PropList.txt: U+001F is not White_Space (Python str.strip removes it; this pipeline must not)

sets.description: Natural key with two components, percent-encoded and joined by '/'.
Position-derived occurrence with a hashed target namespace, 19-digit widths.
Content-addressed identity over bytes the caller has already canonicalized. These vectors test hashing only, never canonicalization (see callerObligations).

callerObligations.text: The bytes are the output of an RDFC-1.0 implementation that passes the W3C RDFC-1.0 test suite, serialized as canonical N-Quads in UTF-8, one line per quad, each terminated by a single LF, with no other bytes.
The recipe's self-reference rule is applied before canonicalization.
Canonicalization stops at the recipe's work budget and the graph is refused, never hashed on a best-effort basis.
Where verifyFullDigest is true, the full digest is stored and compared on every re-registration of the identifier.

sets.description: Random surrogate. Real minting draws 16 bytes from a cryptographically secure source, so real output is testable only by format; these vectors supply the 16 bytes (randomHex) to test the UUIDv4 construction itself.
Adopted identity: nothing is minted, the supplied IRI is validated.
